name: Radxa ROCK 5 ITX
summary: An ARM desktop, from boot to accelerated graphics.
features: NVMe boot, multicore CPU and onboard Ethernet
Mali GPU acceleration with Mesa Panfrost
Rockchip MPP video decoding and analog audio
Intel AX210 Wi-Fi, including tested 802.11ax association
limits: Wi-Fi 6 mode coverage and Bluetooth pairing remain incomplete. Results are specific to the ROCK 5 ITX lab board.

name: Radxa Cubie A7S
summary: A compact ARM desktop with PowerVR graphics and onboard wireless.
features: Bootable SD image and native Haiku desktop
PowerVR BXM-4-64 graphics with Mesa Zink: OpenGL 2.1 and OpenGL ES 2.0
Summit WebGL 1 rendering; software graphics fallback when GPU firmware is unavailable
Onboard AIC8800 Wi-Fi: 5 GHz WPA2, DHCP and automatic reconnection
Bluetooth adapter detection and Low Energy discovery
limits: WebGL 2 is unavailable with the current graphics stack. Bluetooth pairing and audio profiles are not established by the wireless tests. A public SD image has not yet been published.

name: Raspberry Pi 4
summary: A bootable SD image for the small, familiar computer.
features: Desktop on HDMI0, Ethernet and onboard Wi-Fi
Hardware H.264 and HEVC video decoding
Bluetooth discovery and HDMI audio driver
limits: Second HDMI output and Bluetooth pairing are not verified. Audio output has not been listened to. 4K HEVC presentation and H.264 playback have performance limits.

name: x86
summary: Expanded graphics, wireless and peripheral support for 64-bit PCs.
features: NVMe boot, multicore CPUs and Intel I211 Ethernet on the tested AMD workstation
NVIDIA GTX 1070 / 1080 Ti: Vulkan, OpenGL 4.5 and H.264 NVDEC on the 1080 Ti
Two 4K displays with per-monitor scaling and arrangement on NVIDIA
USB 3 storage and gigabit adapters across AMD and ASMedia controllers
MediaTek MT7922 Wi-Fi, Bluetooth discovery and SMB 2/3 network shares
limits: MediaTek Wi-Fi uses legacy rates; Bluetooth pairing and physical display hotplug are unverified. Radeon Pro WX 5100 GPU rendering and H.264/HEVC decoding pass private development trials, but native display, system graphics defaults and a complete release remain unfinished. Suspend resumes with storage and network issues.
